stem.text: Which statement about messenger RNA is correct?

A.text: In eukaryotic cells, mRNA is made by removing exons from the primary RNA transcript.

B.text: mRNA is a single-stranded polynucleotide containing a different purine base than DNA.

C.text: mRNA molecules contain ribose sugars joined to phosphate groups by phosphodiester bonds.

D.text: The monomers of mRNA contain a phosphate group, deoxyribose sugar and a nitrogenous base.
